context: Section 32.5 of the RISC-V Unprivileged Specification defines the OP-V (0x57) instruction encoding for Zvbb, Zvkb, and Zvbc vector bitmanip and carryless multiply instructions, using funct3 fields to distinguish OPIVV, OPIVX, OPIVI, OPMVV, OPMVX, OPFVV, and OPFVF formats.
